CREATE TABLE "public"."payroll_audit_events" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "actorId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "details" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "organizationId" text NOT NULL,
  "payrollEntryId" text,
  "payrollRunId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "payroll_audit_events_action_check_8bd881ff" CHECK ("action" IN ('CREATED', 'CALCULATED', 'ADJUSTED', 'SUBMITTED', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'FINALIZED', 'PAYSLIP_GENERATED', 'PAYSLIP_FAILED', 'PAYMENT_RECORDED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."payroll_entries" (
  "baseAmount" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "compensationType" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "departmentName" text,
  "employeeCode" text NOT NULL,
  "employeeId" text NOT NULL,
  "employeeName" text NOT NULL,
  "grossPay" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "jobTitle" text NOT NULL,
  "netPay" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "organizationId" text NOT NULL,
  "payFrequency" text NOT NULL,
  "payrollRunId" text NOT NULL,
  "payslipFailureCode" text,
  "payslipKey" text,
  "payslipStatus" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "salaryStructureId" text NOT NULL,
  "totalDeductions" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "version" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "payroll_entries_compensationType_check_1a0d65c2" CHECK ("compensationType" IN ('FIXED_SALARY', 'HOURLY')),
  CONSTRAINT "payroll_entries_payFrequency_check_01d702e4" CHECK ("payFrequency" IN ('MONTHLY', 'BIWEEKLY', 'WEEKLY')),
  CONSTRAINT "payroll_entries_payslipStatus_check_64ed587b" CHECK ("payslipStatus" IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."payroll_entry_components" (
  "amount" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isAdjustment" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "organizationId" text NOT NULL,
  "payrollEntryId" text NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "sourceSalaryComponentId" text,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "payroll_entry_components_type_check_950f4ce8" CHECK ("type" IN ('EARNING', 'DEDUCTION'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."payroll_payments" (
  "amount" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "idempotencyKey" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "organizationId" text NOT NULL,
  "paymentDate" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "payrollEntryId" text NOT NULL,
  "recordedById" text NOT NULL,
  "reference" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."payroll_runs" (
  "approvedAt" timestamptz,
  "approvedById" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdById" text NOT NULL,
  "currency" text NOT NULL,
  "employeeCount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "finalizedAt" timestamptz,
  "finalizedById" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "organizationId" text NOT NULL,
  "paymentDate" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "periodEnd" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "periodStart" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "rejectionReason" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'DRAFT' NOT NULL,
  "totalDeductions" numeric(14,2) DEFAULT '0'::numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "totalGross" numeric(14,2) DEFAULT '0'::numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "totalNet" numeric(14,2) DEFAULT '0'::numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "version" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "payroll_runs_status_check_378c53d4" CHECK ("status" IN ('DRAFT', 'PENDING_APPROVAL', 'APPROVED', 'FINALIZED'))
)
